reading: *** THE TORINO NAME INDEX IS NAPOLEONIC ONLY. *** Piedmont was annexed to France, civil registration was kept in French, and *** that is the window Antenati has indexed: about 1805 to 1811. *** *** It does not reach the 1840s to the 1880s, which is the whole of the period that matters for a man who fathered a child in 1882. ***
